declarations.name: sort
declarations.code: type sort = Integer | Boolean

declarations.name: value
declarations.code: type value = Int_value of int | Bool_value of bool

declarations.name: expr
declarations.code:
type expr =
  | Int_lit of int
  | Bool_lit of bool
  | Int_input
  | Bool_input
  | Add of expr * expr
  | Eq_int of expr * expr
  | Int_if of expr * expr * expr
  | Bool_if of expr * expr * expr
[@@inductive]

declarations.name: env
declarations.code: type env = { int_input : int; bool_input : bool }

declarations.name: as_int
declarations.code:
let[@def] (as_int @ total) (value : value @ immutable) =
  match value with Int_value x -> x | Bool_value _ -> 0

declarations.name: as_bool
declarations.code:
let[@def] (as_bool @ total) (value : value @ immutable) =
  match value with Bool_value x -> x | Int_value _ -> false

declarations.name: sort
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (sort @ total) (expr : expr @ immutable) =
  match expr with
  | Int_lit _ | Int_input -> Some Integer
  | Bool_lit _ | Bool_input -> Some Boolean
  | Add (left, right) ->
    (match sort left, sort right with
     | Some Integer, Some Integer -> Some Integer
     | _ -> None)
  | Eq_int (left, right) ->
    (match sort left, sort right with
     | Some Integer, Some Integer -> Some Boolean
     | _ -> None)
  | Int_if (condition, yes, no) ->
    (match sort condition, sort yes, sort no with
     | Some Boolean, Some Integer, Some Integer -> Some Integer
     | _ -> None)
  | Bool_if (condition, yes, no) ->
    (match sort condition, sort yes, sort no with
     | Some Boolean, Some Boolean, Some Boolean -> Some Boolean
     | _ -> None)

declarations.name: eval
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (eval @ total) (expr : expr @ immutable)
    (env : env @ immutable) =
  match expr with
  | Int_lit value -> Int_value value
  | Bool_lit value -> Bool_value value
  | Int_input -> Int_value env.int_input
  | Bool_input -> Bool_value env.bool_input
  | Add (left, right) ->
    Int_value (as_int (eval left env) + as_int (eval right env))
  | Eq_int (left, right) ->
    Bool_value (as_int (eval left env) = as_int (eval right env))
  | Int_if (condition, yes, no) ->
    Int_value (if as_bool (eval condition env)
      then as_int (eval yes env) else as_int (eval no env))
  | Bool_if (condition, yes, no) ->
    Bool_value (if as_bool (eval condition env)
      then as_bool (eval yes env) else as_bool (eval no env))

declarations.name: L
declarations.code: module L = Vox_egraph_language_spec

declarations.name: pat
declarations.code:
type pat =
  | Var of int
  | Int_lit of int
  | Bool_lit of bool
  | Int_input
  | Bool_input
  | Add of pat * pat
  | Eq_int of pat * pat
  | Int_if of pat * pat * pat
  | Bool_if of pat * pat * pat
[@@inductive]

declarations.name: rule
declarations.code: type rule = { vars : L.sort list; lhs : pat; rhs : pat }

declarations.name: t
declarations.code: type t = No_rules | Rule_cons of rule * t [@@inductive]

declarations.name: subst
declarations.code: type subst = L.expr list

declarations.name: lookup_sort
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (lookup_sort @ total) (vars : L.sort list @ immutable)
    (index : int) =
  match vars with
  | [] -> None
  | sort :: rest ->
    if index < 0 then None
    else if index = 0 then Some sort
    else lookup_sort rest (index - 1)

declarations.name: lookup_expr
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (lookup_expr @ total) (subst : subst @ immutable)
    (index : int) =
  match subst with
  | [] -> L.Int_lit 0
  | expr :: rest ->
    if index < 0 then L.Int_lit 0
    else if index = 0 then expr
    else lookup_expr rest (index - 1)

declarations.name: pat_sort
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (pat_sort @ total) (vars : L.sort list @ immutable)
    (pat : pat @ immutable) =
  match pat with
  | Var index -> lookup_sort vars index
  | Int_lit _ | Int_input -> Some L.Integer
  | Bool_lit _ | Bool_input -> Some L.Boolean
  | Add (a, b) ->
    (match pat_sort vars a, pat_sort vars b with
     | Some L.Integer, Some L.Integer -> Some L.Integer
     | _ -> None)
  | Eq_int (a, b) ->
    (match pat_sort vars a, pat_sort vars b with
     | Some L.Integer, Some L.Integer -> Some L.Boolean
     | _ -> None)
  | Int_if (c, y, n) ->
    (match pat_sort vars c, pat_sort vars y, pat_sort vars n with
     | Some L.Boolean, Some L.Integer, Some L.Integer -> Some L.Integer
     | _ -> None)
  | Bool_if (c, y, n) ->
    (match pat_sort vars c, pat_sort vars y, pat_sort vars n with
     | Some L.Boolean, Some L.Boolean, Some L.Boolean -> Some L.Boolean
     | _ -> None)

declarations.name: occurs
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (occurs @ total) (index : int) (pat : pat @ immutable) =
  match pat with
  | Var other -> index = other
  | Int_lit _ | Bool_lit _ | Int_input | Bool_input -> false
  | Add (a, b) | Eq_int (a, b) -> occurs index a || occurs index b
  | Int_if (c, y, n) | Bool_if (c, y, n) ->
    occurs index c || occurs index y || occurs index n

declarations.name: vars_in
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (vars_in @ total) (pat : pat @ immutable)
    (lhs : pat @ immutable) =
  match pat with
  | Var index -> occurs index lhs
  | Int_lit _ | Bool_lit _ | Int_input | Bool_input -> true
  | Add (a, b) | Eq_int (a, b) -> vars_in a lhs && vars_in b lhs
  | Int_if (c, y, n) | Bool_if (c, y, n) ->
    vars_in c lhs && vars_in y lhs && vars_in n lhs

declarations.name: rule_valid
declarations.code:
let[@def] (rule_valid @ total) (rule : rule @ immutable) =
  (match pat_sort rule.vars rule.lhs, pat_sort rule.vars rule.rhs with
   | Some L.Integer, Some L.Integer | Some L.Boolean, Some L.Boolean ->
     true
   | _ -> false) && vars_in rule.rhs rule.lhs

declarations.name: valid
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (valid @ total) (rules : t @ immutable) =
  match rules with
  | No_rules -> true
  | Rule_cons (rule, rest) -> rule_valid rule && valid rest

declarations.name: subst_valid
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (subst_valid @ total) (vars : L.sort list @ immutable)
    (subst : subst @ immutable) =
  match vars, subst with
  | [], [] -> true
  | sort :: vars, expr :: subst ->
    (match sort, L.sort expr with
     | L.Integer, Some L.Integer | L.Boolean, Some L.Boolean -> true
     | _ -> false) && subst_valid vars subst
  | _ -> false

declarations.name: instantiate
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (instantiate @ total) (pat : pat @ immutable)
    (subst : subst @ immutable) =
  match pat with
  | Var index -> lookup_expr subst index
  | Int_lit n -> L.Int_lit n
  | Bool_lit b -> L.Bool_lit b
  | Int_input -> L.Int_input
  | Bool_input -> L.Bool_input
  | Add (a, b) -> L.Add (instantiate a subst, instantiate b subst)
  | Eq_int (a, b) -> L.Eq_int (instantiate a subst, instantiate b subst)
  | Int_if (c, y, n) ->
    L.Int_if (instantiate c subst, instantiate y subst, instantiate n subst)
  | Bool_if (c, y, n) ->
    L.Bool_if (instantiate c subst, instantiate y subst, instantiate n subst)

declarations.name: lookup_rule
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (lookup_rule @ total) (rules : t @ immutable)
    (index : int) =
  match rules with
  | No_rules -> None
  | Rule_cons (rule, rest) ->
    if index < 0 then None
    else if index = 0 then Some rule
    else lookup_rule rest (index - 1)

declarations.name: L
declarations.code: module L = Vox_egraph_language_spec

declarations.name: R
declarations.code: module R = Vox_egraph_rule_spec

declarations.name: evidence
declarations.code:
type evidence =
  | Refl of L.expr
  | Sym of evidence
  | Trans of evidence * evidence
  | Add_cong of evidence * evidence
  | Eq_cong of evidence * evidence
  | Int_if_cong of evidence * evidence * evidence
  | Bool_if_cong of evidence * evidence * evidence
  | Rule of int * R.rule * R.subst
[@@inductive]

declarations.name: endpoints
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (endpoints @ total) (proof : evidence @ immutable) =
  match proof with
  | Refl expr -> (expr, expr)
  | Sym child -> let a, b = endpoints child in (b, a)
  | Trans (first, second) ->
    let a, _ = endpoints first in
    let _, b = endpoints second in
    (a, b)
  | Add_cong (a, b) ->
    let al, ar = endpoints a in
    let bl, br = endpoints b in
    (L.Add (al, bl), L.Add (ar, br))
  | Eq_cong (a, b) ->
    let al, ar = endpoints a in
    let bl, br = endpoints b in
    (L.Eq_int (al, bl), L.Eq_int (ar, br))
  | Int_if_cong (c, y, n) ->
    let cl, cr = endpoints c in
    let yl, yr = endpoints y in
    let nl, nr = endpoints n in
    (L.Int_if (cl, yl, nl), L.Int_if (cr, yr, nr))
  | Bool_if_cong (c, y, n) ->
    let cl, cr = endpoints c in
    let yl, yr = endpoints y in
    let nl, nr = endpoints n in
    (L.Bool_if (cl, yl, nl), L.Bool_if (cr, yr, nr))
  | Rule (_, rule, subst) ->
    (R.instantiate rule.lhs subst, R.instantiate rule.rhs subst)

declarations.name: left
declarations.code:
let[@def] (left @ total) (proof : evidence @ immutable) =
  let a, _ = endpoints proof in a

declarations.name: right
declarations.code:
let[@def] (right @ total) (proof : evidence @ immutable) =
  let _, b = endpoints proof in b

declarations.name: valid
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (valid @ total) (rules : R.t @ immutable)
    (proof : evidence @ immutable) = ghost_ (
  match proof with
  | Refl expr -> (match L.sort expr with Some _ -> true | None -> false)
  | Sym child -> valid rules child
  | Trans (first, second) ->
    valid rules first && valid rules second && right first === left second
  | Add_cong (a, b) | Eq_cong (a, b) ->
    valid rules a && valid rules b && L.sort (left a) === Some L.Integer &&
    L.sort (left b) === Some L.Integer
  | Int_if_cong (c, y, n) ->
    valid rules c && valid rules y && valid rules n &&
    L.sort (left c) === Some L.Boolean &&
    L.sort (left y) === Some L.Integer &&
    L.sort (left n) === Some L.Integer
  | Bool_if_cong (c, y, n) ->
    valid rules c && valid rules y && valid rules n &&
    L.sort (left c) === Some L.Boolean &&
    L.sort (left y) === Some L.Boolean &&
    L.sort (left n) === Some L.Boolean
  | Rule (index, rule, subst) ->
    R.lookup_rule rules index === Some rule &&
    R.rule_valid rule && R.subst_valid rule.vars subst)

declarations.code: module R = Vox_egraph_rule_spec

declarations.name: node
declarations.code:
type node =
  | Int_lit of int
  | Bool_lit of bool
  | Int_input
  | Bool_input
  | Add of int * int
  | Eq_int of int * int
  | Int_if of int * int * int
  | Bool_if of int * int * int
[@@inductive]

declarations.name: graph
node
declarations.code:
let[@def] (node @ total) (graph : graph @ immutable) (id : int) =
  if 0 <= id && id < graph.count && id < Iarray.length graph.nodes then
    Iarray.Refined.get graph.nodes (id)
  else None

declarations.name: class_id
declarations.code:
let[@def] (class_id @ total) (graph : graph @ immutable) (id : int) =
  if 0 <= id && id < graph.count && id < Iarray.length graph.classes then
    Some (Iarray.Refined.get graph.classes (id))
  else None

declarations.name: same
declarations.code:
let[@def] (same @ total) (graph : graph @ immutable) (a : int) (b : int) =
  match class_id graph a, class_id graph b with
  | Some x, Some y -> x = y
  | _ -> false

declarations.name: binding
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (binding @ total) (bindings : int list @ immutable)
    (index : int) =
  match bindings with
  | [] -> None
  | id :: rest ->
    if index < 0 then None
    else if index = 0 then Some id
    else binding rest (index - 1)

declarations.name: member
in_classes
layer
declarations.code:
let[@def] (layer @ total) (graph : graph @ immutable)
    (pat : R.pat @ immutable) (first : int list @ immutable)
    (second : int list @ immutable) (third : int list @ immutable)
    (value : node @ immutable) =
  match pat, value with
  | R.Int_lit a, Int_lit b -> a = b
  | R.Bool_lit a, Bool_lit b -> a = b
  | R.Int_input, Int_input | R.Bool_input, Bool_input -> true
  | R.Add _, Add (a, b) | R.Eq_int _, Eq_int (a, b) ->
    in_classes graph a first && in_classes graph b second
  | R.Int_if _, Int_if (c, a, b) | R.Bool_if _, Bool_if (c, a, b) ->
    in_classes graph c first && in_classes graph a second &&
    in_classes graph b third
  | _ -> false

declarations.name: collect
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (collect @ total) (graph : graph @ immutable)
    (pat : R.pat @ immutable) (first : int list @ immutable)
    (second : int list @ immutable) (third : int list @ immutable)
    (count : int) =
  if count <= 0 then []
  else
    let rest = collect graph pat first second third (count - 1) in
    match node graph (count - 1), class_id graph (count - 1) with
    | Some value, Some label ->
      if layer graph pat first second third value then label :: rest else rest
    | _ -> rest
  [@@decreases if count > 0 then count else 0]

declarations.name: classes
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (classes @ total) (graph : graph @ immutable)
    (pat : R.pat @ immutable) (bindings : int list @ immutable) =
  match pat with
  | R.Var index ->
    (match binding bindings index with
     | None -> []
     | Some id ->
       match class_id graph id with None -> [] | Some label -> [label])
  | R.Add (left, right) | R.Eq_int (left, right) ->
    collect graph pat (classes graph left bindings)
      (classes graph right bindings) [] graph.count
  | R.Int_if (condition, yes, no) | R.Bool_if (condition, yes, no) ->
    collect graph pat (classes graph condition bindings)
      (classes graph yes bindings) (classes graph no bindings) graph.count
  | R.Int_lit _ | R.Bool_lit _ | R.Int_input | R.Bool_input ->
    collect graph pat [] [] [] graph.count

declarations.name: origin
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (origin @ total) (graph : Q.graph @ immutable) (id : int) =
  match Q.node graph id with
  | None -> None
  | Some (Q.Int_lit value) -> Some (L.Int_lit value)
  | Some (Q.Bool_lit value) -> Some (L.Bool_lit value)
  | Some Q.Int_input -> Some L.Int_input
  | Some Q.Bool_input -> Some L.Bool_input
  | Some (Q.Add (a, b)) ->
    if 0 <= a && a < id && 0 <= b && b < id then
      (match origin graph a, origin graph b with
       | Some a, Some b -> Some (L.Add (a, b)) | _ -> None)
    else None
  | Some (Q.Eq_int (a, b)) ->
    if 0 <= a && a < id && 0 <= b && b < id then
      (match origin graph a, origin graph b with
       | Some a, Some b -> Some (L.Eq_int (a, b)) | _ -> None)
    else None
  | Some (Q.Int_if (c, a, b)) ->
    if 0 <= c && c < id && 0 <= a && a < id && 0 <= b && b < id then
      (match origin graph c, origin graph a, origin graph b with
       | Some c, Some a, Some b -> Some (L.Int_if (c, a, b)) | _ -> None)
    else None
  | Some (Q.Bool_if (c, a, b)) ->
    if 0 <= c && c < id && 0 <= a && a < id && 0 <= b && b < id then
      (match origin graph c, origin graph a, origin graph b with
       | Some c, Some a, Some b -> Some (L.Bool_if (c, a, b)) | _ -> None)
    else None
  [@@decreases if id > 0 then id else 0]

declarations.name: origins
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (origins @ total) (before : Q.graph @ immutable)
    (after : Q.graph @ immutable) (count : int) = ghost_ (
  if count <= 0 then true
  else S.origin before (count - 1) === S.origin after (count - 1) &&
    origins before after (count - 1))
  [@@decreases if count > 0 then count else 0]

declarations.name: extends
declarations.code:
let[@def] (extends @ total) (before : Q.graph @ immutable) (after : Q.graph @ immutable) = ghost_ (
  before.count <= after.count && origins before after before.count)

declarations.code: module Q = Vox_egraph_match_spec

declarations.name: node_sort
declarations.code:
let[@def] (node_sort @ total) (node : Q.node @ immutable) =
  match node with
  | Q.Int_lit _ | Q.Int_input | Q.Add _ | Q.Int_if _ -> L.Integer
  | Q.Bool_lit _ | Q.Bool_input | Q.Eq_int _ | Q.Bool_if _ -> L.Boolean

declarations.name: binding_valid
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (binding_valid @ total) (graph : Q.graph @ immutable)
    (vars : L.sort list @ immutable) (bindings : int list @ immutable) =
  match vars, bindings with
  | [], [] -> true
  | sort :: vars, id :: bindings ->
    (if id < 0 then true else
      match Q.node graph id with
      | None -> false
      | Some node ->
        match sort, node_sort node with
        | L.Integer, L.Integer | L.Boolean, L.Boolean -> true
        | _ -> false) && binding_valid graph vars bindings
  | _ -> false

declarations.name: closed_roots
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (closed_roots @ total) (graph : Q.graph @ immutable)
    (rule : R.rule @ immutable) (bindings : int list @ immutable) (count : int) =
  if count <= 0 then true
  else (not (binding_valid graph rule.vars bindings) ||
    not (Q.matches graph rule.lhs bindings (count - 1)) ||
    Q.matches graph rule.rhs bindings (count - 1)) &&
    closed_roots graph rule bindings (count - 1)
  [@@decreases if count > 0 then count else 0]

declarations.name: snoc
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (snoc @ total) (prefix : int list @ immutable) (id : int) =
  match prefix with [] -> [id] | head :: rest -> head :: snoc rest id

declarations.name: C
declarations.code: module C = Vox_egraph_closure_spec

declarations.name: closed_bindings
declarations.code:
val closed_bindings : C.Q.graph @ immutable -> C.R.rule @ immutable ->
    C.L.sort list @ immutable -> int list @ immutable -> int -> bool @@ total

declarations.name: closed_bindings_def
declarations.code:
val closed_bindings_def : (graph : C.Q.graph) @ immutable -> (rule : C.R.rule) @ immutable ->
    (vars : C.L.sort list) @ immutable -> (prefix : int list) @ immutable -> (count : int) ->
    {u : unit | closed_bindings graph rule vars prefix count =
      (match vars with
       | [] -> C.closed_roots graph rule prefix graph.count
       | _ :: rest ->
         if count <= 0 then closed_bindings graph rule rest (C.snoc prefix (-1)) graph.count
         else closed_bindings graph rule rest (C.snoc prefix (count - 1)) graph.count &&
           closed_bindings graph rule vars prefix (count - 1))} @ ghost @@ total

declarations.name: closed_rule
declarations.code:
let[@def] (closed_rule @ total) (graph : Q.graph @ immutable) (rule : R.rule @ immutable) =
  B.closed_bindings graph rule rule.vars [] graph.count

declarations.name: closed_rules
declarations.code:
let[@def] rec (closed_rules @ total) (graph : Q.graph @ immutable) (rules : R.t @ immutable) =
  match rules with
  | R.No_rules -> true
  | R.Rule_cons (rule, rest) -> closed_rule graph rule && closed_rules graph rest

declarations.name: Q
declarations.code: module Q = Vox_egraph_match_spec

declarations.name: same_node
declarations.code:
let[@def] (same_node @ total) (graph : Q.graph @ immutable)
    (left : Q.node @ immutable) (right : Q.node @ immutable) =
  match left, right with
  | Q.Int_lit a, Q.Int_lit b -> a = b
  | Q.Bool_lit a, Q.Bool_lit b -> a = b
  | Q.Int_input, Q.Int_input | Q.Bool_input, Q.Bool_input -> true
  | Q.Add (a, b), Q.Add (x, y) | Q.Eq_int (a, b), Q.Eq_int (x, y) ->
    Q.same graph a x && Q.same graph b y
  | Q.Int_if (c, a, b), Q.Int_if (z, x, y)
  | Q.Bool_if (c, a, b), Q.Bool_if (z, x, y) ->
    Q.same graph c z && Q.same graph a x && Q.same graph b y
  | _ -> false

declarations.name: pair
declarations.code:
let[@def] (pair @ total) (graph : Q.graph @ immutable) (left : int) (right : int) =
  match Q.node graph left, Q.node graph right with
  | Some a, Some b -> not (same_node graph a b) || Q.same graph left right
  | _ -> true

declarations.name: sound
declarations.code:
val sound :
    (rules : R.t) @ immutable -> (proof : E.evidence) @ immutable ->
    (env : L.env) @ immutable ->
    ((index : int) -> (rule : R.rule) @ immutable ->
      (subst : R.subst) @ immutable ->
      {u : unit | R.lookup_rule rules index === Some rule &&
        R.rule_valid rule && R.subst_valid rule.vars subst} ->
      {u : unit | L.eval (R.instantiate rule.lhs subst) env ===
        L.eval (R.instantiate rule.rhs subst) env} @ ghost) @ total ->
    {u : unit | E.valid rules proof} ->
    {u : unit | L.eval (E.left proof) env ===
      L.eval (E.right proof) env} @ ghost @@ total

declarations.name: t
declarations.code: type t : value mod logical

declarations.name: model
declarations.code: val model : t @ local immutable -> Q.graph @ immutable ghost @@ total

declarations.name: rules
declarations.code: val rules : t @ local immutable -> R.t @ immutable ghost @@ total

declarations.name: create
declarations.code:
val create : (input_rules : {rs : R.t | R.valid rs}) @ immutable ->
    {state : t | (model state).count = 0 && rules state === input_rules} @ unique

declarations.name: admit_result
declarations.code: type admit_result = #{id : int option @@ aliased; state : t}

declarations.name: admit
declarations.code:
val admit : (state : t) @ unique -> (expr : L.expr) @ immutable ->
    {r : admit_result | rules r.#state === rules state &&
      Preserves.extends (model state) (model r.#state) &&
      (match r.#id with
       | None -> L.sort expr === None || (model r.#state).count = 512
       | Some id -> 0 <= id && id < (model r.#state).count &&
         Snapshot.origin (model r.#state) id === Some expr)} @ unique

declarations.name: E
declarations.code: module E = Vox_egraph_derivation_spec

declarations.name: Fixed
declarations.code: module Fixed = Vox_egraph_fixedpoint_spec

declarations.name: equality
declarations.code: type equality = Equal | Not_proved | Invalid_input | Node_limit

declarations.name: query_result
declarations.code: type query_result = #{status : equality; state : t; proof : E.evidence option @@ ghost aliased}

declarations.name: query
declarations.code:
val query : (state : t) @ unique -> (left : L.expr) @ immutable -> (right : L.expr) @ immutable ->
    {r : query_result | rules r.#state === rules state &&
      Preserves.extends (model state) (model r.#state) &&
      (match r.#status, r.#proof with
       | Equal, Some proof -> E.valid (rules state) proof &&
         E.left proof === left && E.right proof === right
       | Not_proved, None -> true
       | Invalid_input, None -> L.sort left === None || L.sort right === None
       | Node_limit, None -> (model r.#state).count = 512
       | _ -> false)} @ unique

declarations.name: saturation_status
declarations.code: type saturation_status = Fixed_point | Saturation_node_limit | Search_limit | Rebuild_limit | Round_limit

declarations.name: saturation_result
declarations.code: type saturation_result = #{status : saturation_status; fuel : int; state : t}

declarations.name: saturate
declarations.code:
val saturate : (state : t) @ unique -> (rounds : int) -> (rebuild_passes : int) ->
    (fuel : {f : int | 0 <= f && f <= 4611686018427387903}) ->
    {r : saturation_result | rules r.#state === rules state &&
      Preserves.extends (model state) (model r.#state) &&
      0 <= r.#fuel && r.#fuel <= fuel &&
      (match r.#status with
       | Fixed_point -> Fixed.fixed (model r.#state) (rules state)
       | Saturation_node_limit -> (model r.#state).count = 512
       | Search_limit -> r.#fuel = 0
       | Rebuild_limit | Round_limit -> true)} @ unique

declarations.name: class_result
declarations.code: type class_result = #{equal : bool; state : t; proof : E.evidence option @@ ghost aliased}

declarations.name: same_class
declarations.code:
val same_class : (state : t) @ unique ->
    (a : {i : int | 0 <= i && i < (model state).count}) ->
    (b : {i : int | 0 <= i && i < (model state).count}) ->
    {r : class_result | model r.#state === model state && rules r.#state === rules state &&
      r.#equal = Q.same (model state) a b && (a <> b || r.#equal) &&
      (match r.#proof with
       | None -> not r.#equal
       | Some proof -> r.#equal && E.valid (rules state) proof &&
         Snapshot.origin (model state) a === Some (E.left proof) &&
         Snapshot.origin (model state) b === Some (E.right proof))} @ unique @@ total

(* Observation lemmas. *)

declarations.name: model_bounds
declarations.code:
val model_bounds :
    (state : t) @ local immutable total ghost forkable unyielding ->
    {u : unit | 0 <= (model state).count && (model state).count <= 512
      && (model state).count <= Iarray.length (model state).nodes
      && (model state).count <= Iarray.length (model state).classes
      && R.valid (rules state)} @ ghost @@ total

declarations.name: preserved_origin
declarations.code:
val preserved_origin : (before : Q.graph) @ immutable -> (after : Q.graph) @ immutable -> (id : int) ->
    {u : unit | Preserves.extends before after && 0 <= id && id < before.count} ->
    {u : unit | Snapshot.origin before id === Snapshot.origin after id} @ ghost @@ total

declarations.name: Iarray.length
declarations.code:
external length :
  ('a : any mod separable).
  ('a iarray[@local_opt]) @ immutable contended -> int
  @@ total = "%array_length"
[@@layout_poly]

declarations.name: Iarray.Refined.get
declarations.code:
module Refined : sig
  (** Bounds-checked operations whose bounds are expressed in their types. *)

  external get :
    ('a : any mod separable).
    (a : ('a iarray[@local_opt])) ->
    {i : int | 0 <= i && i < length a} ->
    ('a[@local_opt]) @ total @@ total = "%array_safe_get"
  [@@layout_poly]
end
